es: Buenos días, ¿cómo está usted?
en: Good morning, how do you do?
ipa_rp: /ɡʊd ˈmɔːnɪŋ haʊ duː juː duː/
notes: RP greeting: 'how do you do' is more formal than 'how are you'. The 'o' in 'morning' is /ɔː/ not /oʊ/.

es: El tiempo está bastante horrible hoy.
en: The weather is rather dreadful today.
ipa_rp: /ðə ˈweðə ɪz ˈrɑːðə ˈdrɛdf(ə)l təˈdeɪ/
notes: Key RP features: non-rhotic (silent R in 'weather', 'rather'), /ð/ not /d/ for 'the', /ɑː/ in 'rather'.

es: ¿Dónde está la estación de tren?
en: Where is the railway station?
ipa_rp: /weə ɪz ðə ˈreɪlweɪ ˈsteɪʃ(ə)n/
notes: Non-rhotic 'where' = /weə/ not /wɛr/. Schwa in '-tion' ending.

es: Me gustaría un vaso de agua, por favor.
en: I'd like a glass of water, please.
ipa_rp: /aɪd laɪk ə ɡlɑːs əv ˈwɔːtə pliːz/
notes: Bath vowel: 'glass' = /ɡlɑːs/ (RP bath broadening, not /glæs/). Non-rhotic 'water'.

es: Pasa la mantequilla, por favor.
en: Could you pass the butter, please?
ipa_rp: /kʊd juː pɑːs ðə ˈbʌtə pliːz/
notes: /ʌ/ in 'butter' — Spanish speakers often say /a/. Bath broadening in 'pass'.

es: Voy al teatro esta tarde.
en: I'm going to the theatre this evening.
ipa_rp: /aɪm ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈθɪətə ðɪs ˈiːvnɪŋ/
notes: /θ/ in 'theatre' and 'this'. RP diphthong /əʊ/ (not /oʊ/) in 'going'. Non-rhotic 'theatre'.

es: El baño es absolutamente maravilloso.
en: The bath is absolutely marvellous.
ipa_rp: /ðə bɑːθ ɪz ˈæbsəluːtli ˈmɑːv(ə)ləs/
notes: Bath broadening: 'bath' = /bɑːθ/ not /bæθ/. /θ/ at end of 'bath' — don't say /bɑːf/.

es: Me temo que el tren llegó tarde.
en: I'm afraid the train was rather late.
ipa_rp: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðə treɪn wɒz ˈrɑːðə leɪt/
notes: RP /ɒ/ in 'was' — short rounded vowel. Non-rhotic 'rather'. 'I'm afraid' is a very RP softener.

es: Ella habló con claridad durante la reunión.
en: She spoke clearly throughout the meeting.
ipa_rp: /ʃiː spəʊk ˈklɪəli θruːˈaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
notes: /θ/ in 'throughout'. RP diphthong /əʊ/ in 'spoke'. /ɪə/ in 'clearly'.

es: ¿Podría llamarme un taxi, por favor?
en: Could you ring for a taxi, please?
ipa_rp: /kʊd juː rɪŋ fər ə ˈtæksi pliːz/
notes: /ɪ/ in 'ring' — short, not the Spanish /i/. 'ring' is RP word for calling.

es: Creo que va a llover esta tarde.
en: I think it's going to rain this afternoon.
ipa_rp: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪts ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə reɪn ðɪs ɑːftəˈnuːn/
notes: /θ/ in 'think' — tongue between teeth. Bath broadening in 'afternoon' = /ɑːftə/.

es: Prefiero el té con leche fría.
en: I prefer my tea with cold milk.
ipa_rp: /aɪ prɪˈfɜː maɪ tiː wɪð kəʊld mɪlk/
notes: Non-rhotic 'prefer' = /prɪˈfɜː/. /ɜː/ is a tricky RP vowel. /ð/ in 'with'.

es: Qué sorpresa tan agradable verte aquí.
en: What a pleasant surprise to see you here.
ipa_rp: /wɒt ə ˈplɛz(ə)nt səˈpraɪz tə siː juː hɪə/
notes: /ɒ/ in 'what'. RP diphthong /ɪə/ in 'here'. Non-rhotic 'surprise'.

es: ¿Serías tan amable de abrir la puerta?
en: Would you be so kind as to open the door?
ipa_rp: /wʊd juː biː səʊ kaɪnd æz tə ˈəʊp(ə)n ðə dɔː/
notes: Non-rhotic 'door' = /dɔː/. RP diphthong /əʊ/ in 'so' and 'open'.

es: El parque se ve muy hermoso en primavera.
en: The park looks rather splendid in spring.
ipa_rp: /ðə pɑːk lʊks ˈrɑːðə ˈsplɛndɪd ɪn sprɪŋ/
notes: Bath broadening: 'park' = /pɑːk/. Non-rhotic: silent R. /ɪ/ in 'splendid', 'in', 'spring'.

es: Estoy pensando en irme al campo este fin de semana.
en: I'm thinking of going to the countryside this weekend.
ipa_rp: /aɪm ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əv ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈkʌntrisaɪd ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd/
notes: /θ/ in 'thinking'. /ʌ/ in 'countryside' — not /a/. /əʊ/ in 'going'. Lots of /ð/.

es: Sin lugar a dudas, fue el mejor concierto de mi vida.
en: Without doubt, it was the finest concert I've ever heard.
ipa_rp: /wɪðˈaʊt daʊt ɪt wɒz ðə ˈfaɪnɪst ˈkɒnsət aɪv ˈɛvə hɜːd/
notes: /ð/ in 'without', 'the'. Non-rhotic: 'concert'=/ˈkɒnsət/, 'heard'=/hɜːd/, 'ever'=/ˈɛvə/.

es: Me parece que tiene usted razón.
en: I rather think you're right, you know.
ipa_rp: /aɪ ˈrɑːðə θɪŋk jɔː raɪt juː nəʊ/
notes: Very RP phrasing. Non-rhotic 'rather', 'you're'. /əʊ/ in 'know'. 'you know' = /juː nəʊ/.

es: Las flores en el jardín son absolutamente preciosas.
en: The flowers in the garden are absolutely gorgeous.
ipa_rp: /ðə ˈflaʊəz ɪn ðə ˈɡɑːd(ə)n ɑː ˈæbsəluːtli ˈɡɔːdʒəs/
notes: Non-rhotic throughout: 'flowers'=/ˈflaʊəz/, 'garden'=/ˈɡɑːd(ə)n/, 'gorgeous'=/ˈɡɔːdʒəs/.

es: ¿Qué tal si tomamos una taza de té?
en: Shall we have a cup of tea?
ipa_rp: /ʃæl wiː hæv ə kʌp əv tiː/
notes: /æ/ in 'shall', 'have'. /ʌ/ in 'cup' — not /a/. Very RP social phrase.

es: Discúlpame, no te vi ahí.
en: I beg your pardon, I didn't see you there.
ipa_rp: /aɪ bɛɡ jɔː ˈpɑːd(ə)n aɪ ˈdɪd(ə)nt siː juː ðeə/
notes: Classic RP apology. Non-rhotic 'pardon'=/ˈpɑːd(ə)n/, 'your'=/jɔː/. /ðeə/ in 'there'.

es: ¿Podría hablar más despacio, por favor?
en: Would you mind speaking a little more slowly?
ipa_rp: /wʊd juː maɪnd ˈspiːkɪŋ ə ˈlɪt(ə)l mɔː ˈsləʊli/
notes: /ɔː/ in 'more' (non-rhotic). RP diphthong /əʊ/ in 'slowly'. /ɪ/ in 'little', 'speaking'.

es: Sería un placer acompañarle a cenar.
en: I should be delighted to join you for dinner.
ipa_rp: /aɪ ʃʊd biː dɪˈlaɪtɪd tə dʒɔɪn juː fə ˈdɪnə/
notes: Very formal RP phrasing. Non-rhotic 'dinner'=/ˈdɪnə/. /ɔɪ/ diphthong in 'join'.

es: El norte de Inglaterra es verdaderamente hermoso.
en: The north of England is truly breathtaking.
ipa_rp: /ðə nɔːθ əv ˈɪŋɡlənd ɪz ˈtruːli ˈbrɛθteɪkɪŋ/
notes: /θ/ in 'north', 'breathtaking'. Non-rhotic 'north'=/nɔːθ/. Cluster /brɛθ/ is tricky.

es: Fue un absoluto placer conocerle. Espero que volvamos a vernos pronto.
en: It's been an absolute pleasure. I do hope we shall meet again.
ipa_rp: /ɪts bɪn ən ˈæbsəluːt ˈplɛʒə aɪ duː həʊp wiː ʃæl miːt əˈɡɛn/
notes: Non-rhotic 'pleasure'=/ˈplɛʒə/. /æ/ in 'absolute'. RP intensifier 'I do hope'. Classic farewell.
